messages:
Anita (Partner AE): Hey team — ZenithEdge wants a shared sandbox for a joint co-sell demo next Wed afternoon. They need a tenant with private connectivity (Azure Private Link), a service account, and a short runbook for cert rotation and billing tags. What's the fastest way to provision and what entitlements do we need?

Maya (Solutions Eng): We can do a sandbox tenant under `partner-sandboxes`. Quick checklist: 1) entitle partner org (partner API keys + demo role), 2) provision PL endpoint + NSG rules, 3) create mTLS cert and demo SA with least privilege, 4) enable telemetry + billing tags. I'll draft the runbook.

Leo (Platform): +1. Note: private link changes egress path — need to confirm egress billing split. Anita, are we covering egress cost for demo or partner? Also which model families should be enabled (gpt-mid, gpt-large)? Larger models may need dedicated quantized pools.

Sam (Security): Quick security flags: partner requested SOC2 language in the SQA, IP allowlist for the demo tenant, and an option to purge logs. Need to confirm retention windows and whether audit logs include token-level traces. If they want source IP preservation via PL, we should ensure NAT passthrough is configured.

infra-bot: Tenant provision command suggestion:
```
/provision-sandbox --org zenithedge --env demo --private-link true --models gpt-mid,gpt-large --admins maya,leo
```
Docs: https://rows.redwood.dev/partner-sandboxes

Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll own the runbook and demo SA. Leo — can you file the Private Link/netops request? ETA EOD today?

Leo (Platform): Filing netops ticket now. Ticket: NETOPS-4921. Also: certificate rotation requires us to provide CSR to partner or accept their cert? Sam, is HSM-backed key material required for the POC?

Sam (Security): HSM optional for the demo. For enterprise POC they'll want HSM/KMS integration — flag that in SOW. I'll start the SQA answers for data flow and retention. Anita, can you attach the partner's SQA PDF here?

Anita (Partner AE): Uploading SQA now to the channel. Finance is asking about co-billing: partner is proposing they cover 20% of egress for demo traffic — can we tag and split?

Maya (Solutions Eng): For demo we can cap egress via rate limits and tag traffic so finance can allocate costs. Proposed tags: `partner:zenith` and `demo:true`. I'll include tagging steps in runbook.

Leo (Platform): Confirmed — will add billing tags to provisioning flow and include cost split notes in NETOPS-4921. Netops owner: @nina.

Anita (Partner AE): Timeline check — netops ticket + runbook by EOD, provisioning by tomorrow morning, demo test Tuesday. Realistic?

Maya (Solutions Eng): Yes. I'll push a runbook draft here in ~2 hours with a test checklist and sample mTLS configuration.

Maya (Solutions Eng): az snippet for PL provisioning:
```
az network private-endpoint create -n zenith-pl -g rnd-partners --vnet-name demo-vnet --subnet private-sub --private-connection-resource-id /subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.Network/privateLinkServices/pl-id
```

Sam (Security): Add a step to verify audit log streaming to partner SIEM only after contract is signed. For demo, logs -> S3 temp bucket with 7-day retention. Also include step to validate rotation of demo certs.

Anita (Partner AE): Awesome, thanks all. @Maya @Leo @Sam ping me if anything blocks — partner is keen to lock in date. :thumbsup: 

Maya (Solutions Eng): Noted. I'll post runbook link and test checklist when ready.

Leo (Platform): NETOPS-4921 updated — ETA tomorrow 9am PT.

Anita (Partner AE): Great — I'll sync with ZenithEdge and confirm timing on our side.
